svg.title: RocketMQ-Rust architecture
svg.desc: Producers and consumers find Brokers through the NameServer cluster. A broker group has a master and an HA replica; each Broker stores messages through rocketmq-store, with a local engine by default and optional RocksDB and tiered engines. A Raft-based Controller promotes a replica when a master fails, and the Proxy accepts gRPC clients. Admin CLI, TUI, dashboards and the MCP server reach the cluster through rocketmq-admin-core and the client SDK. Shared crates provide the model, protocol, transport, runtime, security, error, observability, filter and macro foundations. Where motion is allowed, a looping tour plays seven steps: register, discover, send, persist, consume, fail over and operate.
svg.text: Follow a message from producer to consumer
Route discovery, sending, persistence, replication and delivery: every hop of the RocketMQ model, implemented in async Rust.
